verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Call History for viewing performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data after calls, plus per-call webhooks that push data to a CRM. Neither is live call monitoring or alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes. Post-hoc review and per-call data pushes are adjacent features, and a user would have to build any alerting on top of them, so no credit is earned.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can monitor live calls in production and get alerts when agents misbehave or error rates spike
